packs.title: Gulf to Gardens
packs.promise: Explore Clearwater’s shore, marine care, parks and cultural venues across separate outings.

q.t: A Pier at the Gulf Edge
q.s: Read a public pier as an observation point.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose an open section of the park or the city pier map and locate one Gulf-facing viewpoint.
Record how the pier, sand and public path meet; fishing and an evening market are optional.

q.s: Compare Gulf beach and sheltered marsh.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From an open county path or park map, locate one Gulf-facing and one sheltered habitat view.
Sketch how public access protects the marsh and keeps beach use separate.

q.s: Choose a short nature route for an inland view.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose a paved or natural city trail that is open and leads toward a lake view.
Record one change in vegetation and a safe return point; do not rely on a wildlife sighting.

packs.title: Downtown to Harbor
packs.promise: Follow downtown streets from the east gateway to the working harbor in one or two afternoons.

q.s: Read the pedestrian corridor as a route.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Choose one public block of Cleveland Street and identify a crossing, shaded edge or active frontage.
Record how the street links the east gateway with the waterfront without relying on a shop purchase.

q.s: Trace a performance venue from the public sidewalk.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
Observe the theatre’s public facade or official seating plan and identify one arrival feature.
Sketch how its entrance frames a performance night without implying a show is underway.

q.t: A Park that Opens to the Bay
q.s: Compare a civic entry with an open harbor lawn.
st: Check current access, then choose an open public view or official-source route.
From an open public path, identify the civic gateway, lawn or waterfront edge.
Record how the park connects downtown streets to Clearwater Harbor; no concert is required.
